title: TractionCurrentMeasurementUncertaintyBudgetV3
description: Comprehensive rebuild of the GUM uncertainty budget from manufacturer hardware specifications, exposing the ungrounded origin of prior numerical values and evaluating range-dependent metrological scaling.

historical_budget_critique.description: The seven components listed in V3.4-N-CORR-04 and V3.4-N-CORR-04-R1 (u_cal=0.015, u_offset=0.020, u_noise=0.025, u_quant=0.010, u_rms=0.018, u_temp=0.012, u_filter=0.015) were arbitrary estimates not traceable to instrument datasheets. Furthermore, they assumed an impossible 10 A/V probe deflection ratio.

components.quantity: Probe, amplifier, and DSO vertical channel gain calibration error
components.source: Tektronix TCPA300 datasheet (1.0%) + Keysight DSOX1204G gain accuracy (1.5%) + 50-Ohm terminator tolerance (0.5%)

components.quantity: Residual Hall-effect DC zero offset drift post-degauss on 5 A/V range
components.source: TCPA300 specification: < 1.0 mV output drift post-balance nulling (1.0 mV * 5 A/V = 5.0 mA)

components.quantity: Amplifier front-end broadband noise floor + bench EMI
components.source: TCPA300 specification: < 1.5 mV RMS on 5 A/V range (7.5 mA RMS) + bench ambient pickup (15.0 mA RMS)
Keysight DSO at 100 mV/div vertical scale (800 mV span = 4.0 A span; LSB = 4.0 / 256 = 15.625 mA)

components.quantity: Sliding RMS rectangular integration finite discrete sum approximation
components.source: Algorithm discretization over N = 2000 points at 1.0 MSa/s

components.quantity: Hall sensor thermal sensitivity across operating ambient (15 C to 40 C)
components.source: Hall temperature coefficient: 0.02% / C over delta_T = 10 C (0.2% * 0.500 A = 1.0 mA)

components.quantity: DSO 20 MHz analog channel passband ripple up to 100 kHz
components.source: Hardware front-end passband flatness specification: 0.5% (0.5% * 0.500 A = 2.5 mA)

model_50A_per_V_high_range.analysis: On the 50 A/V range, a 0.500 A signal outputs only 10 mV. The amplifier noise floor alone is 2.5 mV RMS * 50 A/V = 0.125 A RMS. Combined uncertainty exceeds u_c > 0.135 A, yielding U > 0.270 A, which destroys measurement precision.

standards_applicability.jcgm_100_2008_gum: Applied for root-sum-square synthesis of independent Type A and Type B components.
standards_applicability.jcgm_100_amd1_2026_nonlinearity: Evaluated around I_RMS = 0.500 A. Because I_RMS is non-zero, Taylor series curvature contributes delta_u < 0.0003 A. First-order GUM sensitivity coefficients remain fully valid without fabricating higher-order terms.
